assets.what: Stage backdrop: dark haunted late-night TV studio, low contrast for readable text (pixel art converted from the earlier Gemini backdrop)
assets.prompt: (image-to-pixelart takes no prompt.) Converted from the earlier Gemini backdrop, kept in tools/art/sources/. Its prompt: Wide establishing shot of an empty late-night TV variety show studio after midnight, haunted but cosy and inviting, inspired by Japanese tsukumogami folklore. A small stage with heavy velvet curtains, an old wooden host desk at one side, a stack of old CRT television monitors glowing faintly, unlit studio spotlights on a rig overhead, a few paper lanterns giving soft warm glows, faint wisps of ghostly mist drifting across the floor, a few loose blank dictionary pages floating gently in the air. Very dark and low contrast overall, muted deep purple and indigo tones (#14101f, #1f1930) with small accents of warm coral (#ff7a59) and mint (#57d9a3) light, slightly soft focus, the centre of the image is calm, dark and empty so text can be placed over it. Painterly cartoon background art style matching a cute game. No people, no characters, no faces, no text, no letters, no signs, no logos, no watermark.
